title: PR8438 Staging runtime attestation trusted-ingress digest derivation

phases.objective: Derive the runtime-artifact trusted-ingress public-key digest from the canonical live Gateway public-key PEM instead of requiring a non-existent public_key_sha256 field, while preserving exact-SHA, signer separation, and no-mutation boundaries.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A live-shaped recoveryTrustedIngress object containing key_id and public_key yields a canonical 64-hex trusted_ingress.public_key_sha256 in the signed runtime-artifact payload without requiring an undeclared Gateway response field.
steps: Canonicalize the public-key PEM using the same newline contract used by Staging trust certification.
Derive SHA-256 from the canonical PEM and require a valid key ID and 64-hex digest before signing.
Populate the runtime-artifact payload from the derived digest.
Reject regression to direct gatewayTrust.public_key_sha256 reads.
assertions: The signer consumes recoveryTrustedIngress.public_key from the live Gateway contract.
The payload trusted_ingress.public_key_sha256 is derived deterministically from canonical PEM bytes.
The legacy direct gatewayTrust.public_key_sha256 read is absent.
The existing distinct runtime-signing-key versus Gateway-ingress-key invariant remains unchanged.
Live Staging certification is required after merge.
No Production, provider, Cloudflare, database, schema, DNS, or credential mutation is introduced by this PR.
